milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/observe' task — the player must navigate toward the dark_oak_wood hollow cube structure and face it to visually identify it. The target is the center of the structure at spawn-relative (5, 2, 5). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure.

Uses inventory_has because crafting birch_planks results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 4 birch_log but NO birch_planks, so any birch_planks in inventory confirms successful crafting. Recipe: 1 birch_log → 4 birch_planks (works in 2x2 inventory grid or crafting table).

Uses inventory_has because crafting an acacia_button results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 4 acacia_log but NO acacia_button or acacia_planks, so any acacia_button in inventory confirms successful two-step crafting (acacia_log → acacia_planks → acacia_button). Both steps fit in the 2x2 inventory grid.
